reason: I only have weekends, so $59 a month would work out to maybe four visits, and library storytime and the parks cost nothing. The place is new and I would not pay a monthly fee for something I have never seen.
objection: $59 a month for weekends only is a lot when free options exist, and I would be paying before I know my kid even likes it.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit, plus a weekend-only membership around $30 a month.
